name: Iizuna (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iizuna town emblem in green and orange: a green stylised mountain range of three peaks with a white blossom bearing orange dots.
history: Municipal flag of Iizuna, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Iizuna town emblem — a green stylised mountain range of three peaks with a white blossom bearing orange dots
